english: A calm look back at yesterday when you open Replay in the morning — and one memory to carry into today.
uz: Ertalab Replay’ni ochganingizda kechagi kunga tinch nazar — va bugunga olib o‘tadigan bitta xotira.

english: A chapter exists only while the days beneath it do.
uz: Bob faqat ostidagi kunlar turgan ekan mavjud bo‘ladi.

english: A clock above the day's total, for a screen you glance at rather than sit in front of.
uz: Kun jamisi ustidagi soat — old tomonida o‘tirmay, ko‘z tashlab o‘tadigan ekran uchun.

english: A curated walk through the best of your history.
uz: Tarixingizning eng yaxshi qismlari bo‘ylab tanlangan sayr.

english: A flat surface. The quietest, and the easiest to read over.
uz: Tekis yuza. Eng tinchi va ustidan o‘qish eng osoni.

english: A look back every Sunday evening at the week just gone.
uz: Har yakshanba oqshomi o‘tgan haftaga nazar.

english: A once-a-day reminder of what you were doing on this date in the past.
uz: O‘tmishda shu sanada nima qilganingiz haqida kuniga bir marta eslatma.

english: A part becomes a ritual once the same app has led it on more than one day. Read only from your history — nothing set, nothing scheduled.
uz: Kunning bir qismi bir necha kun davomida bitta ilova yetakchilik qilsa, odatga aylanadi. Faqat tarixingizdan o‘qiladi — hech narsa belgilanmaydi, hech narsa rejalashtirilmaydi.

english: A private timeline of the apps you use. Everything stays on this Mac.
uz: Siz ishlatadigan ilovalarning shaxsiy vaqt chizig‘i. Hammasi shu Mac’da qoladi.

english: A quiet clock in the corner. The one thing you are likely to want from a screen you are walking past.
uz: Burchakdagi tinch soat. Yonidan o‘tib ketayotgan ekrandan odam istaydigan yagona narsa.

english: A quiet look back, before the day begins.
uz: Kun boshlanishidan oldin — orqaga tinch nazar.

english: A quiet walk through the best of your history — the memories, the deep focus, the things you kept.
uz: Tarixingizning eng yaxshi qismlari bo‘ylab tinch sayr — xotiralar, chuqur fokus, saqlab qo‘yganlaringiz.

english: A recap of the day's focus, delivered at the time you choose.
uz: Kun fokusining xulosasi — siz tanlagan vaqtda yetkaziladi.

english: A slow swell on the application's icon, so a screen of live figures does not read as a still picture of one. Off leaves ambient mode completely still. Reduce Motion turns it off either way.
uz: Ilova belgisining sekin kengayishi — jonli raqamlar ekrani qotib qolgan rasmdek ko‘rinmasligi uchun. O‘chirilsa, ambient rejimi butunlay harakatsiz bo‘ladi. “Harakatni kamaytirish” uni baribir o‘chiradi.

english: All memories are generated locally. Nothing is uploaded.
uz: Barcha xotiralar shu yerda hosil qilinadi. Hech narsa yuklanmaydi.

english: Any time — from the menu bar or Privacy ▸ Activity tracking. Replay stops recording immediately, and your history is left untouched.
uz: Istalgan vaqtda — menyu panelidan yoki Maxfiylik ▸ Faoliyatni yozib borish orqali. Replay darhol yozishni to‘xtatadi, tarixingiz esa tegilmasdan qoladi.

english: As the days add up, Replay gathers the ones that share a character into chapters you can revisit and name — a week or two of history is enough for the first.
uz: Kunlar to‘planib borgani sari Replay o‘xshash tabiatli kunlarni boblarga jamlaydi — ularni qayta ko‘rish va nomlash mumkin. Birinchisi uchun bir-ikki haftalik tarix yetarli.

english: As the days repeat, Replay notices the app you usually open first and the ones that tend to lead each part of your day.
uz: Kunlar takrorlangani sari Replay odatda birinchi ochadigan ilovangizni va kuningizning har qismiga yetakchilik qiladigan ilovalarni sezadi.

english: As the days, chapters, and projects accumulate, this becomes a lasting archive of your digital history.
uz: Kunlar, boblar va loyihalar to‘plangani sari bu raqamli tarixingizning uzoq saqlanadigan arxiviga aylanadi.

english: As you use your Mac, each day will fill in here.
uz: Mac’ingizdan foydalanganingiz sari har bir kun shu yerda to‘lib boradi.

english: As you work, bookmark a session, and jot a reflection, the most meaningful pieces of your history gather here.
uz: Ishlaganingiz, seansni xatcho‘plaganingiz va mulohaza yozganingiz sari tarixingizning eng ma’noli qismlari shu yerda to‘planadi.

english: Before the day ends — what would you like to remember about it?
uz: Kun tugamasdan oldin — bu kun haqida nimani eslab qolishni istaysiz?

english: Blurred, with depth but no shine.
Both write while Replay is running — a background courtesy, not a daemon, so a Mac that was off has nothing to catch up. Each keeps its eight most recent and removes only its own.
uz: Ikkalasi ham Replay ishlab turganda yozadi — bu fon xizmati emas, oddiy xushmuomalalik; o‘chiq turgan Mac’da qoldirilgan ish bo‘lmaydi. Har biri o‘zining eng so‘nggi sakkiztasini saqlaydi va faqat o‘zinikini o‘chiradi.

english: Can ambient mode drift in on its own too?
uz: Ambient rejimi ham o‘zi ochila oladimi?

english: Can I delete a single day?
Can I delete just one session?
Can I stop Replay recording an app?
uz: Replay ma’lum bir ilovani yozmasligi mumkinmi?

english: Can I write something to remember about a day?
uz: Kun haqida eslab qolish uchun biror narsa yoza olamanmi?

english: Choose a folder for Replay to write reports into.
Choose apps Replay should never record. Excluding one also removes its history.
uz: Replay hech qachon yozmasligi kerak bo‘lgan ilovalarni tanlang. Ilovani chiqarib tashlash uning tarixini ham o‘chiradi.

english: Darker is busier. Click a day to replay it.
uz: Qanchalik to‘q bo‘lsa, shunchalik band. Kunni bosing — u qayta o‘ynaladi.

english: Data ▸ Export report saves a slice as Markdown, PDF, HTML, CSV, or JSON — the HTML report carries app icons and styling, and PDF stays to one page with a pointer to HTML for longer spans. A single day exports from the ⋯ menu on its divider in the Timeline. Full backup exports the whole database, and importing merges rather than overwriting.
uz: Ma’lumotlar ▸ Hisobotni eksport qilish bo‘limi tanlangan qismni Markdown, PDF, HTML, CSV yoki JSON sifatida saqlaydi — HTML hisobotida ilova belgilari va uslub bo‘ladi, PDF esa bir sahifada qoladi va uzunroq oraliqlar uchun HTML’ga yo‘naltiradi. Bitta kunni Vaqt chizig‘idagi ajratgich yonidagi ⋯ menyusidan eksport qilasiz. To‘liq zaxira butun bazani eksport qiladi, import esa ustiga yozmaydi — qo‘shib boradi.

english: Deletes all activity, settings, and preferences, then returns to the welcome screen.
uz: Barcha faoliyat, sozlama va afzalliklarni o‘chiradi, so‘ng xush kelibsiz ekraniga qaytaradi.

english: Deletes every event, headline, note and bookmark. There is no undo.
uz: Har bir hodisa, sarlavha, eslatma va xatcho‘pni o‘chiradi. Ortga qaytarish yo‘q.

english: Deleting rows frees space inside the database file without shrinking the file itself; the room is kept for future writes. Replay rewrites the file after a large deletion so the space returns to your disk, and Data ▸ Storage ▸ Compact database does it on demand and tells you how much came back.
uz: Qatorlarni o‘chirish baza fayli ichida joy bo‘shatadi, lekin faylning o‘zini kichraytirmaydi; bu joy keyingi yozuvlar uchun saqlanadi. Katta o‘chirishdan so‘ng Replay faylni qayta yozadi va joy diskingizga qaytadi; Ma’lumotlar ▸ Xotira ▸ Bazani ixchamlash buni talab bo‘yicha bajaradi va qancha joy qaytganini aytadi.

english: Different lenses on the same local history. Collections gather your sessions by the kind of work they were. Projects surface the app combinations that keep recurring, and let you name them. The Canvas lays your projects, apps, collections, chapters and moments out as an explorable space you can pan and zoom — click a memory to focus what connects to it, double-click to open it, or open a synced timeline beside it. Nothing to set up; it fills in as Replay runs.
uz: Bitta mahalliy tarixga turlicha qarashlar. To‘plamlar seanslaringizni ish turiga ko‘ra jamlaydi. Loyihalar takrorlanib turadigan ilova birikmalarini ko‘rsatadi va ularga nom berish imkonini beradi. Kanva loyihalar, ilovalar, to‘plamlar, boblar va lahzalarni suzib va masshtablab kezish mumkin bo‘lgan makon sifatida yoyadi — xotirani bosing, u bilan bog‘liqlari ajralib chiqadi; ikki marta bosing, ochiladi; yonida sinxron vaqt chizig‘ini ham ochish mumkin. Hech narsa sozlash shart emas; Replay ishlagan sari o‘zi to‘ladi.

english: Dismiss the screensaver on a mouse click or tap.
Dismiss the screensaver on any key. Esc and the ✕ always close it, whatever these are set to.
uz: Istalgan tugma bosilganda skrinseyverni yopish. Esc va ✕ bu sozlamalardan qat’i nazar doim yopadi.

english: Dismiss the screensaver when the pointer moves. Off by default, so a hand-started screensaver stays until you reach for it.
uz: Kursor harakatlanganda skrinseyverni yopish. Odatda o‘chirilgan — qo‘lda ishga tushirilgan skrinseyver siz qo‘l uzatguningizcha turadi.

english: Does Replay ever use the network?
Drift ambient mode in after this long with no activity, while Replay is focused. Any key or movement wakes it.
uz: Replay fokusda turganda, shuncha vaqt harakatsizlikdan so‘ng ambient rejimi sekin paydo bo‘lsin. Istalgan tugma yoki harakat uni uyg‘otadi.

english: Drift the screensaver in after this long with no activity, while Replay is focused. Any key or movement wakes it.
uz: Replay fokusda turganda, shuncha vaqt harakatsizlikdan so‘ng skrinseyver sekin paydo bo‘lsin. Istalgan tugma yoki harakat uni uyg‘otadi.

english: Either drifts in only while Replay's own window is in front, so it never appears over another app. Never means neither does, and both can still be opened by hand from the sidebar, the View menu or ⌘K. What starts on its own leaves the way it came: any key, click or movement returns you — including in ambient mode, which stays put when you open it yourself, since that is the point of it.
uz: Ikkalasi ham faqat Replay oynasi oldinda turganda paydo bo‘ladi, shuning uchun boshqa ilova ustiga hech qachon chiqmaydi. “Hech qachon” — hech biri chiqmaydi degani; ikkalasini ham yon panel, View menyusi yoki ⌘K orqali qo‘lda ochish mumkin. O‘zi ochilgani o‘zi ketadi: istalgan tugma, bosish yoki harakat sizni qaytaradi — shu jumladan ambient rejimida ham; o‘zingiz ochsangiz esa u joyida qoladi, chunki butun gap shunda.

english: Every page is holding live data, so there is little to recover — compaction has real work to do after you delete history.
uz: Har bir sahifada jonli ma’lumot bor, shuning uchun qaytariladigan narsa kam — tarixni o‘chirganingizdan keyin ixchamlashning ishi bo‘ladi.

english: Every sentence is drawn only from your own local history. Nothing is invented.
uz: Har bir jumla faqat sizning mahalliy tarixingizdan olinadi. Hech narsa to‘qib chiqarilmaydi.

english: Everything here was recorded on this Mac and has never left it.
uz: Bu yerdagi hamma narsa shu Mac’da yozilgan va undan hech qachon chiqmagan.

english: Everything Replay has gained, newest first.
uz: Replay qo‘lga kiritgan hamma narsa — eng yangisi birinchi.

english: Excluding an app also erases the history it already has.
uz: Ilovani chiqarib tashlash uning mavjud tarixini ham o‘chiradi.

english: Export the entire database as JSON, or import one — importing merges, never overwrites.
uz: Butun bazani JSON sifatida eksport qiling yoki bittasini import qiling — import qo‘shib boradi, hech qachon ustiga yozmaydi.

english: Go to a surface, an application, a project, a day…
uz: Bo‘limga, ilovaga, loyihaga yoki kunga o‘tish…

english: Granted — not needed, and safe to remove
uz: Berilgan — kerak emas, olib tashlash mumkin

english: Hide the Dock icon and keep Replay running in the menu bar.
uz: Dock belgisini yashirib, Replay’ni menyu panelida ishlatib turish.

english: How do I keep a copy of my history?
How do I start the screensaver, and how does it close?
uz: Skrinseyverni qanday ishga tushiraman va u qanday yopiladi?

english: How does Replay know what I’m doing?
How much focused time you're aiming for each day.
uz: Har kuni qancha fokusli vaqtni maqsad qilganingiz.

english: How much history the Timeline shows
How much space does Replay use?
How sure Replay must be before surfacing a memory. Higher means rarer, but only when it truly matters.
uz: Xotirani ko‘rsatishdan oldin Replay qanchalik ishonchi komil bo‘lishi kerak. Yuqoriroq — kamroq, lekin faqat haqiqatan ahamiyatli bo‘lganda.

english: I deleted history but the size on disk didn't change — why?
uz: Tarixni o‘chirdim, lekin diskdagi hajm o‘zgarmadi — nega?

english: In a single database file in your own user folder — the Privacy tab shows the exact path. It never leaves this Mac: no cloud, no account, no network.
uz: O‘z foydalanuvchi jildingizdagi bitta baza faylida — aniq manzil Maxfiylik bo‘limida ko‘rsatilgan. U shu Mac’dan hech qachon chiqmaydi: bulut yo‘q, hisob yo‘q, tarmoq yo‘q.

english: It notices which application is frontmost using macOS’s standard app-switch signal, and records the app’s name and how long it stayed in front. Never what’s inside a window, never your keystrokes, never content.
uz: U macOS’ning ilova almashuvi haqidagi standart signali orqali qaysi ilova oldinda ekanini sezadi va ilova nomi bilan qancha vaqt oldinda turganini yozadi. Oyna ichidagi narsalarni emas, tugma bosishlaringizni emas, mazmunni esa hech qachon.

english: Keep ambient mode up while you carry on working, instead of it closing the moment you touch the keyboard. It takes the whole screen it is on, so this only applies when that is a screen other than the one Replay's window is on — otherwise there would be nothing to work in.
uz: Klaviaturaga tegishingiz bilan yopilib qolmasdan, siz ishlayotganingizda ambient rejimi ochiq tursin. U turgan ekranni butunlay egallaydi, shuning uchun bu faqat Replay oynasi turgan ekrandan boshqa ekran bo‘lgandagina amal qiladi — aks holda ishlash uchun joy qolmaydi.

english: Keep the drift to a span of the day — an evening, or the hours you are at this desk. Outside it nothing starts on its own, and both can still be opened by hand.
uz: Buni kunning ma’lum oralig‘i bilan cheklang — oqshom yoki shu stol yonida bo‘ladigan soatlaringiz. Undan tashqarida hech narsa o‘zi ochilmaydi, ikkalasini ham qo‘lda ochsa bo‘ladi.

english: Leave it empty to go back to the name Replay chose.
uz: Replay tanlagan nomga qaytish uchun bo‘sh qoldiring.

english: Leave it open while you work
macOS does not let an app read this one
uz: macOS bunga ilovaning qarashiga ruxsat bermaydi

english: Match the system or lock to a single appearance.
uz: Tizimga moslash yoki bitta ko‘rinishda qotirish.

english: Memories resurfaces past days that share today’s date, so it only has the history Replay has recorded so far. It fills in over the coming weeks and months — the longer Replay runs, the richer it gets.
uz: Xotiralar bugungi sanaga to‘g‘ri keladigan o‘tgan kunlarni qaytaradi, shuning uchun unda faqat Replay shu paytgacha yozgan tarix bo‘ladi. Kelasi haftalar va oylarda u to‘lib boradi — Replay qancha uzoq ishlasa, shuncha boy bo‘ladi.

english: MIT licensed. Built on this Mac, and it stays here.
uz: MIT litsenziyasi ostida. Shu Mac’da yig‘ilgan va shu yerda qoladi.

english: No memories for this date yet
uz: Bu sana uchun hali xotira yo‘q

english: No session in this range is in the kinds of work, or the layers, you chose.
uz: Bu oraliqdagi birorta seans siz tanlagan ish turlari yoki qatlamlarga tushmaydi.

english: No sessions in the kept window for this memory.
uz: Bu xotira uchun saqlangan oynada seans yo‘q.
Bu kun uchun vaqt chizig‘i yo‘q

english: No. The daily, weekly, and “on this day” recaps are built entirely from your local data and delivered by macOS. Nothing is uploaded, and there’s no account behind them.
uz: Yo‘q. Kunlik, haftalik va “shu kunda” xulosalari butunlay mahalliy ma’lumotlaringizdan tuziladi va macOS orqali yetkaziladi. Hech narsa yuklanmaydi va ular ortida hech qanday hisob yo‘q.

english: None for the tracking itself. Replay reads which app is frontmost through macOS’s standard app-switch signal, which any app can observe — so it needs no Accessibility, Automation, or App Management permission, and it never inspects your window contents. Privacy ▸ Recording shows a live check that it’s working, with links into System Settings if you’re on a managed Mac that asks for Accessibility anyway.
uz: Yozib borishning o‘zi uchun hech qanday ruxsat kerak emas. Replay qaysi ilova oldinda ekanini macOS’ning standart ilova almashuvi signali orqali biladi — uni istalgan ilova kuzatishi mumkin. Shuning uchun unga Accessibility, Automation yoki App Management ruxsatlari kerak emas va u oyna mazmunini hech qachon ko‘rmaydi. Maxfiylik ▸ Yozib borish bo‘limi buning ishlayotganini jonli ko‘rsatadi; boshqariladigan Mac’da Accessibility so‘ralsa, Tizim sozlamalariga havolalar ham bor.

english: Not used. Replay never modifies another application.
uz: Ishlatilmaydi. Replay boshqa ilovani hech qachon o‘zgartirmaydi.

english: Not used. Replay reads the frontmost application from macOS itself.
uz: Ishlatilmaydi. Replay old plandagi ilovani macOS’ning o‘zidan o‘qiydi.

english: Nothing has been written yet. Choosing a folder with a schedule set writes the first copy straight away, and the rest arrive while Replay is running — it is a background courtesy, not a daemon, so a Mac that was off has nothing to catch up.
uz: Hali hech narsa yozilmagan. Jadval belgilangan holda jild tanlansa, birinchi nusxa darhol yoziladi, qolganlari Replay ishlab turganda paydo bo‘ladi — bu fon xizmati emas, oddiy xushmuomalalik; o‘chiq turgan Mac’da qoldirilgan ish bo‘lmaydi.

english: Nothing recorded in that period — no report written.
uz: Bu davrda hech narsa yozilmagan — hisobot yozilmadi.

english: Nothing recorded yet. Your sessions will appear here as you work.
uz: Hali hech narsa yozilmagan. Ishlaganingiz sari seanslaringiz shu yerda paydo bo‘ladi.

english: Nothing to open for this one.
Observe which apps you use to build your private timeline.
uz: Shaxsiy vaqt chizig‘ingizni tuzish uchun qaysi ilovalarni ishlatishingizni kuzatish.

english: Off, which is all Replay needs
uz: O‘chiq — Replay uchun shuning o‘zi yetarli

english: Older raw events are removed past this window. Keeping everything never deletes a thing; your day-by-day headlines are kept either way, so history and streaks survive.
uz: Bu oraliqdan eski xom hodisalar o‘chiriladi. “Hammasini saqlash” hech narsani o‘chirmaydi; kunlik sarlavhalaringiz baribir saqlanadi, shuning uchun tarix ham, ketma-ketliklar ham qoladi.

english: Once a day, ask GitHub whether a newer Replay exists. This is the only thing in the app that uses the network, and it sends nothing about you or your record — the same request as opening the releases page in a browser. Nothing is downloaded or installed; you are told, and you decide.
uz: Kuniga bir marta GitHub’dan yangiroq Replay bor-yo‘qligini so‘rash. Bu ilovadagi tarmoqdan foydalanadigan yagona narsa va u siz yoki yozuvingiz haqida hech narsa yubormaydi — brauzerda relizlar sahifasini ochish bilan bir xil so‘rov. Hech narsa yuklab olinmaydi va o‘rnatilmaydi; sizga aytiladi, qaror sizniki.

english: Once Replay has recorded a few days, it will begin telling the story of each week, month, and year back to you here.
uz: Replay bir necha kunni yozib olgach, har hafta, oy va yilning hikoyasini shu yerda sizga aytib bera boshlaydi.

english: Once you have used a few, Replay will rank them here by the time you spent in each.
uz: Bir nechtasini ishlatganingizdan so‘ng, Replay ularni shu yerda sarflagan vaqtingizga qarab tartiblaydi.

english: Only a bundled copy of Replay has permissions to reset.
uz: Faqat to‘liq o‘rnatilgan Replay nusxasida qayta o‘rnatiladigan ruxsatlar bo‘ladi.

english: Only if you ask it to, and it is off when you install it. Settings ▸ About can check GitHub once a day for a newer version. That request sends nothing — no account, no identifier, nothing about your record — and is the same one your browser makes opening the releases page. It tells you and stops there: nothing is downloaded or installed on your behalf. Leave it off and Replay opens no connection at all, ever.
uz: Faqat siz so‘rasangiz, va o‘rnatganingizda u o‘chirilgan bo‘ladi. Sozlamalar ▸ Haqida bo‘limi kuniga bir marta GitHub’dan yangiroq versiyani tekshirishi mumkin. Bu so‘rov hech narsa yubormaydi — hisob ham, identifikator ham, yozuvingiz haqida hech narsa — va brauzeringiz relizlar sahifasini ochganda yuboradigan so‘rovning aynan o‘zi. U sizga xabar beradi va shu yerda to‘xtaydi: sizning nomingizdan hech narsa yuklab olinmaydi va o‘rnatilmaydi. O‘chirib qo‘ysangiz, Replay umuman hech qanday ulanish ochmaydi.

english: Only the recaps use this. Replay records, remembers and shows your history whether or not it is granted.
uz: Buni faqat xulosalar ishlatadi. Ruxsat berilgan-berilmaganidan qat’i nazar, Replay tarixingizni yozadi, eslaydi va ko‘rsatadi.
Qayta kashf etishga arziydigan kunni ochish

english: Opens how these two are used together
uz: Bu ikkisi qanday birga ishlatilishini ochadi

english: Opens the day this happened on
Opens the day you wrote it on
Permanently delete every event Replay has recorded on this Mac.
uz: Replay shu Mac’da yozgan har bir hodisani butunlay o‘chirish.

english: Pick up where you left off
Put this memory away for now
Puts Replay in the list so you only have to turn it on
uz: Replay’ni ro‘yxatga qo‘shadi — sizga faqat yoqish qoladi

english: Read Replay in a language your Mac is not set to. Anything this build has not been translated into stays in English rather than showing you a key.
uz: Replay’ni Mac’ingizda o‘rnatilmagan tilda o‘qing. Bu qurilmada tarjima qilinmagan narsalar kalit ko‘rsatilishi o‘rniga ingliz tilida qoladi.

english: Reduce Transparency in System Settings overrides this and makes every surface solid.
uz: Tizim sozlamalaridagi “Shaffoflikni kamaytirish” buni bekor qiladi va har bir yuzani qattiq qiladi.

english: Replay hasn’t recorded this application in the last 30 days.
uz: Replay so‘nggi 30 kunda bu ilovani yozmagan.

english: Replay reads which app is frontmost through macOS's standard signal. It needs no Accessibility, Automation, or Screen Recording permission, and never looks inside your windows.
uz: Replay qaysi ilova oldinda ekanini macOS’ning standart signali orqali o‘qiydi. Unga Accessibility, Automation yoki Screen Recording ruxsati kerak emas va u oynalaringiz ichiga hech qachon qaramaydi.

english: Replay reads which app is frontmost through macOS’s standard signal — it needs no Accessibility, Automation, or App Management permission to do it, and never looks inside your windows. The links are only for verifying, or a locked-down Mac.
uz: Replay qaysi ilova oldinda ekanini macOS’ning standart signali orqali o‘qiydi — buning uchun unga Accessibility, Automation yoki App Management ruxsati kerak emas va u oynalaringiz ichiga hech qachon qaramaydi. Havolalar faqat tekshirish uchun yoki cheklovli Mac uchun.

english: Replay records with none of these. They are here so a managed Mac can be checked, and so anything granted earlier can be taken back — "Reset" removes Replay from that list in System Settings.
uz: Replay bularning hech biriga muhtoj emas. Ular boshqariladigan Mac’ni tekshirish uchun va ilgari berilgan ruxsatni qaytarib olish uchun shu yerda — “Qayta o‘rnatish” Replay’ni Tizim sozlamalaridagi o‘sha ro‘yxatdan olib tashlaydi.

english: Replay shows at most one memory a day, and most days it shows none. The briefing is a look back at yesterday, and it is gone by lunchtime. Everything either says is read from your own history on this Mac.
uz: Replay kuniga ko‘pi bilan bitta xotira ko‘rsatadi, ko‘p kunlari esa umuman ko‘rsatmaydi. Xulosa — kechagi kunga nazar, va u tushlik vaqtiga borib yo‘qoladi. Ikkalasi aytadigan hamma narsa shu Mac’dagi o‘z tarixingizdan o‘qiladi.

english: Replay sometimes surfaces a memory on its own — what is that?
uz: Replay ba’zan o‘zi xotira ko‘rsatadi — bu nima?

english: Replay wasn’t running or tracking was paused
uz: Replay ishlamayotgan edi yoki kuzatuv to‘xtatilgan edi

english: Replay will stop recording it, and will erase everything it has already recorded for it. That cannot be undone — un-excluding later resumes recording but does not bring the history back.
uz: Replay uni yozishni to‘xtatadi va u haqda yozilgan hamma narsani o‘chiradi. Buni ortga qaytarib bo‘lmaydi — keyinroq ro‘yxatdan chiqarsangiz yozish qayta boshlanadi, lekin tarix qaytmaydi.
Oldingi oylar uchun yon tomonga suring.

english: Show the introduction again in the main window.
Show the memory card on Today, and the Memories view in the sidebar.
uz: Bugun bo‘limida xotira kartasini, yon panelda esa Xotiralar bo‘limini ko‘rsatish.

english: Show the occasional inline memory on Today when the moment fits. Each one can be dismissed.
uz: Payti kelganda Bugun bo‘limida vaqti-vaqti bilan xotira ko‘rsatish. Har birini yopib qo‘yish mumkin.

english: Show the sessions behind the selection
Show today's active hours on the Dock icon. Appears once you've been active an hour.
uz: Bugungi faol soatlarni Dock belgisida ko‘rsatish. Bir soat faol bo‘lganingizdan keyin paydo bo‘ladi.

english: Start it from the Screensaver button at the bottom of the sidebar, from ⌘K ▸ Screensaver, or let it drift in on its own — General ▸ Screensaver can auto-start it after a spell of inactivity. Esc and the ✕ always close it; whether a click, a key, or mouse movement also closes it is up to you in that same section (mouse movement is off by default, so a hand-started screensaver stays put).
uz: Uni yon panel pastidagi Skrinseyver tugmasidan, ⌘K ▸ Skrinseyver orqali ishga tushiring yoki o‘zi paydo bo‘lishiga qo‘ying — Umumiy ▸ Skrinseyver bo‘limi uni bir muddat harakatsizlikdan so‘ng avtomatik ochishi mumkin. Esc va ✕ uni doim yopadi; bosish, tugma yoki sichqoncha harakati ham yopishi shu bo‘limda sizning ixtiyoringizda (sichqoncha harakati odatda o‘chirilgan, shuning uchun qo‘lda ochilgan skrinseyver joyida turadi).

english: Takes that day's sessions, summary, reflection, and any notes or bookmarks with it, and leaves every other day untouched. Any day can also be deleted — or exported on its own — from the ⋯ menu on its divider in the Timeline.
uz: O‘sha kunning seanslari, xulosasi, mulohazasi va undagi eslatma yoki xatcho‘plarni birga olib ketadi, qolgan kunlarga tegmaydi. Istalgan kunni Vaqt chizig‘idagi ajratgich yonidagi ⋯ menyusidan ham o‘chirish — yoki alohida eksport qilish — mumkin.

english: That’s Contextual Memory Intelligence: when something becomes relevant — you return to an app after a while away, an anniversary comes round, a bookmark has been sitting unopened — Replay quietly surfaces it on Today, and stays silent when nothing is worth saying. Every card can be dismissed, and you can tune how often it speaks, or turn it off entirely, in Settings ▸ General ▸ Contextual memories.
uz: Bu — Kontekstli Xotira Intellekti: biror narsa ahamiyatli bo‘lib qolganda — ancha vaqtdan keyin ilovaga qaytsangiz, yubiley kelsa, xatcho‘p ochilmay yotgan bo‘lsa — Replay uni Bugun bo‘limida sokin ko‘rsatadi, aytishga arziydigan narsa bo‘lmasa jim turadi. Har bir kartani yopish mumkin; qanchalik tez-tez gapirishini Sozlamalar ▸ Umumiy ▸ Kontekstli xotiralar bo‘limida sozlaysiz yoki butunlay o‘chirasiz.

english: The application you are in right now, with its icon. Turn it off for a screen other people can see.
uz: Hozir ishlayotgan ilovangiz, belgisi bilan. Boshqalar ko‘radigan ekran uchun o‘chirib qo‘ying.

english: The day's total is always shown — it is what the screen is for. These are the things around it, and two of them are here because an ambient screen is usually a second screen, and a second screen is often one other people can see. A screen left open takes no keyboard, so Escape does not reach it: close it with ⇧⌘A, the View menu, or the ✕ in its corner.
uz: Kun jamisi doim ko‘rsatiladi — ekran shuning uchun. Bular uning atrofidagi narsalar, ulardan ikkitasi shu yerda, chunki ambient ekrani odatda ikkinchi ekran bo‘ladi, ikkinchi ekranni esa ko‘pincha boshqalar ham ko‘radi. Ochiq qoldirilgan ekran klaviaturani olmaydi, shuning uchun Escape unga yetib bormaydi: uni ⇧⌘A, View menyusi yoki burchagidagi ✕ bilan yoping.

english: The long view of your work — told back to you, gathered into eras, and reflected in the rhythms you fall into.
uz: Ishingizga uzoq nazar — sizga qaytarib aytiladi, davrlarga jamlanadi va odat bo‘lib qolgan ritmlaringizda aks etadi.

english: The system's own material, with its edge and its light.
uz: Tizimning o‘z materiali — qirrasi va yorug‘i bilan.

english: The system's own material, with its edge and its light. Reduce Transparency in System Settings overrides this and makes every surface solid.
uz: Tizimning o‘z materiali, cheti va yorug‘i bilan. Tizim sozlamalaridagi “Shaffoflikni kamaytirish” buni bekor qiladi va har bir sirtni qattiq qiladi.

english: The view Replay shows when the window opens.
The whole of it at a glance — how long you've been building, and everything it holds.
uz: Hammasi bir qarashda — qancha vaqtdan beri qurayotganingiz va u nimalarni saqlayotgani.

english: The whole of it, at a glance — how long you've been building this memory, and everything it holds.
uz: Hammasi bir qarashda — bu xotirani qancha vaqtdan beri to‘playotganingiz va u nimalarni saqlayotgani.

english: There is no undo — export a backup first if you want to keep your timeline.
uz: Ortga qaytarish yo‘q — vaqt chizig‘ingizni saqlamoqchi bo‘lsangiz, avval zaxira nusxasini eksport qiling.

english: These three are the screensaver's own, and apply however it was started. Opening either of the two displays closes the other; they are never both up, and neither ever covers the one you are deliberately reading. Escape and the close button always dismiss whichever is up, whatever these say.
uz: Bu uchtasi skrinseyverning o‘ziga tegishli va u qanday ishga tushgan bo‘lsa ham amal qiladi. Ikki ekrandan birini ochish ikkinchisini yopadi; ikkalasi hech qachon birga turmaydi va hech biri siz ataylab o‘qiyotganini bosib qolmaydi. Escape va yopish tugmasi bu sozlamalardan qat’i nazar ochiq turganini doim yopadi.

english: These two apps haven’t been used together in the last 30 days.
uz: Bu ikki ilova so‘nggi 30 kunda birga ishlatilmagan.

english: Very little — Replay records no video, screenshots, or window contents, only which app was in front and when. That's a few hundred kilobytes for a heavy day, so tens of megabytes across a year. Privacy shows the database's exact size and where it lives.
uz: Juda kam — Replay video, ekran rasmlari yoki oyna mazmunini yozmaydi, faqat qaysi ilova qachon oldinda bo‘lganini yozadi. Bu og‘ir kun uchun bir necha yuz kilobayt, ya’ni bir yilda o‘nlab megabayt. Maxfiylik bo‘limi bazaning aniq hajmi va qayerda turishini ko‘rsatadi.

english: What are Collections, Projects, and the Canvas?
What Replay is calling this stretch of work, and when it began.
uz: Replay bu ish oralig‘ini qanday nomlayotgani va u qachon boshlangani.

english: Where should Replay keep its backups?
Where should Replay write its reports?
Where the reports go. Markdown or HTML, because a report that arrives on its own might cover a busy week, and PDF is one page with a pointer to HTML.
uz: Hisobotlar qayerga tushadi. Markdown yoki HTML — chunki o‘zi keladigan hisobot band haftani qamrashi mumkin, PDF esa bir sahifa va qolgani uchun HTML’ga yo‘naltiradi.

english: Where those copies go. Somewhere that is itself backed up is the point: a second copy on the same disk survives a mistake, not a failure.
uz: O‘sha nusxalar qayerga tushadi. Gap shundaki, o‘zi ham zaxiralanadigan joy tanlang: bitta diskdagi ikkinchi nusxa xatodan qutqaradi, nosozlikdan emas.

english: Where your time went this month.
Where your time went this week.

Which of the two takes the screen when the delay below runs out. The screensaver drifts through the day you have had; ambient mode holds today's total still, in type you can read from across the room.
uz: Quyidagi kechikish tugaganda ekranni ikkisidan qaysi biri egallaydi. Skrinseyver o‘tgan kuningiz bo‘ylab sekin suriladi; ambient rejimi esa bugungi jamini qimirlatmay, xonaning narigi burchagidan o‘qiladigan shriftda ushlab turadi.

english: Which screen the screensaver and ambient mode take. Replay follows the keyboard unless you name one; a named screen that is unplugged falls back to the keyboard's and is remembered for when it returns.
uz: Skrinseyver va ambient rejimi qaysi ekranni egallaydi. Siz ekranni ko‘rsatmasangiz, Replay klaviatura ortidan boradi; ko‘rsatilgan ekran uzilgan bo‘lsa, klaviatura ekraniga qaytadi va qayta ulanganda esga olinadi.

english: Write a report of the period that has just finished — yesterday, or the week just gone — into a folder you choose. A backup is insurance you hope never to open; this is the one file here meant to be read.
uz: Endigina tugagan davr — kecha yoki o‘tgan hafta — haqidagi hisobotni siz tanlagan jildga yozish. Zaxira — ochmaslikka umid qiladigan sug‘urta; bu esa shu yerdagi o‘qish uchun mo‘ljallangan yagona fayl.

english: Write the same full backup on a schedule, without being asked. Nothing leaves this Mac — it is a file in a folder you choose, and Replay keeps the eight most recent and removes its own older ones.
uz: O‘sha to‘liq zaxirani so‘ralmasdan, jadval bo‘yicha yozib turish. Hech narsa shu Mac’dan chiqmaydi — bu siz tanlagan jilddagi fayl; Replay eng so‘nggi sakkiztasini saqlaydi va o‘zining eskilarini o‘chiradi.

english: Written from your own history and handed to macOS already composed. Nothing is uploaded, and Replay asks for permission only when you switch one of these on.
uz: O‘z tarixingizdan yozilib, macOS’ga tayyor holda beriladi. Hech narsa yuklanmaydi va Replay ruxsatni faqat shulardan birini yoqqaningizda so‘raydi.

english: Yes — a Reflection. On Today, and on any past day you open, there’s a line to jot what you’d like to remember. It’s kept locally with everything else and turns up in Search. You can also press Replay Day on Today to watch the day play back as a short movie.
uz: Ha — Mulohaza. Bugun bo‘limida va ochgan har qanday o‘tgan kunda eslab qolmoqchi bo‘lganingizni yozadigan satr bor. U qolgan hamma narsa bilan birga shu yerda saqlanadi va Qidiruvda chiqadi. Bugun bo‘limidagi Replay kuni tugmasini bosib, kunni qisqa film sifatida ko‘rish ham mumkin.

english: Yes — open a session and use the ⋯ menu at the foot of it, or right-click the session anywhere it appears. Either removes exactly that run and any note or bookmark on it; the rest of the day stays, and the day's totals are restated to match. That same ⋯ menu exports just that session.
uz: Ha — seansni oching va uning pastidagi ⋯ menyusidan foydalaning yoki seans qayerda ko‘rinsa, o‘ng tugma bilan bosing. Ikkalasi ham aynan o‘sha seansni va undagi eslatma yoki xatcho‘pni o‘chiradi; kunning qolgani joyida qoladi va kun jamilari mos ravishda qayta hisoblanadi. O‘sha ⋯ menyusi faqat o‘sha seansni eksport ham qiladi.

english: Yes — Privacy ▸ Excluded applications. Excluding an app also erases the history already recorded for it, so it leaves no trace.
uz: Ha — Maxfiylik ▸ Chiqarilgan ilovalar. Ilovani chiqarib tashlash u haqda yozilgan tarixni ham o‘chiradi, shuning uchun hech qanday iz qolmaydi.

english: Yes, and it is the same delay. Settings ▸ Display opens with the choice: which of the two takes the screen when you have been quiet, and after how long. It arrives only while Replay's own window is in front, so it never covers another app — and an ambient screen that started itself leaves on any key, click or movement. One you open by hand stays until you close it, which is what a second monitor is for.
uz: Ha, va kechikish ham o‘sha. Sozlamalar ▸ Ekran bo‘limi shu tanlov bilan ochiladi: siz jim bo‘lganingizda ikkisidan qaysi biri ekranni egallaydi va qancha vaqtdan keyin. U faqat Replay oynasi oldinda turganda paydo bo‘ladi, shuning uchun boshqa ilovani hech qachon bosib qolmaydi — o‘zi ochilgan ambient ekrani esa istalgan tugma, bosish yoki harakatda ketadi. Qo‘lda ochganingiz siz yopmaguningizcha turadi — ikkinchi monitor shuning uchun.

english: Yes, three ways: the ⋯ menu on that day's divider in the Timeline, the same ⋯ menu on the day's own page, or Data ▸ Storage ▸ Delete a single day. Any of them removes that day's sessions, its summary, its reflection, and any notes or bookmarks on it, and leaves every other day alone. For bigger sweeps, Data ▸ Storage can stop keeping raw activity past 90 days, 6 months, or a year, and Privacy ▸ Clear History erases everything.
uz: Ha, uch yo‘l bilan: Vaqt chizig‘ida o‘sha kun ajratgichidagi ⋯ menyusi, kunning o‘z sahifasidagi o‘sha ⋯ menyusi yoki Ma’lumotlar ▸ Xotira ▸ Bitta kunni o‘chirish. Har biri o‘sha kunning seanslari, xulosasi, mulohazasi va undagi eslatma yoki xatcho‘plarni o‘chiradi, qolgan kunlarga tegmaydi. Kattaroq tozalash uchun Ma’lumotlar ▸ Xotira bo‘limi xom faoliyatni 90 kun, 6 oy yoki bir yildan keyin saqlashni to‘xtatishi mumkin, Maxfiylik ▸ Tarixni tozalash esa hammasini o‘chiradi.

english: Your history divided into the eras it naturally fell into.
uz: Tarixingiz o‘zi tabiiy ravishda bo‘lingan davrlarga ajratilgan.

english: Your history told back to you, a month or a year at a time.
uz: Tarixingiz sizga qaytarib aytiladi — bir oy yoki bir yildan.

english: Your history, divided into the eras it naturally fell into — and yours to name.
uz: Tarixingiz o‘zi tabiiy ravishda bo‘lingan davrlarga ajratilgan — nomini o‘zingiz qo‘yasiz.

english: Your history, told back to you — a week, a month, or a year at a time, only from what you actually did.
uz: Tarixingiz sizga qaytarib aytiladi — bir hafta, bir oy yoki bir yildan, faqat siz haqiqatan qilgan ishlardan.

english: Your record is untouched — an update replaces the app, not the history.
uz: Yozuvingizga tegilmagan — yangilanish ilovani almashtiradi, tarixni emas.

english: Your story is still being written
